description: Ameren, formed in 1997 and headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, is a public utility holding company whose primary assets are its equity interests in its subsidiaries, which are separate, independent legal entities with separate businesses, assets and liabilities, and dividends on Ameren's common stock and the payment of expenses by Ameren depend on distributions made to it by its subsidiaries. Its principal subsidiaries are Ameren Missouri, which operates a rate-regulated electric generation, transmission and distribution business and a rate-regulated natural gas distribution business in Missouri; Ameren Illinois, which operates rate-regulated electric transmission, electric distribution and natural gas distribution businesses in Illinois; and ATXI, which operates a FERC rate-regulated electric transmission business in the MISO.
